label: TP
reason: User input from request parameters flows directly into bar via HashMap retrieval (L51), then concatenates into SQL query (L62) which is executed via JDBC template (L63). Although ESAPI encoder is applied later to the SQL string for HTML encoding, the SQL execution itself still uses unencoded user data, creating an actual SQL injection vector on the reported path.

evidence.note: User param flows to bar via HashMap get(), then used in SQL query execution
